description: Book recommendations from books the reader loved, named by title: "books like Project Hail Mary", "I loved Circe and Piranesi, what else would I like", a book club's favorite pick. Books they disliked go in avoid ("I loved these three but not that one"). Unresolved titles come back under unmatched, never guessed. The named authors' other books are left out. For a linked reader, books they already have, hid or avoided are left out, and a result that fits their taste says why.

avoid.description: Books the reader disliked or does not want; "Title by Author" resolves best
